name: copy-text
title: Copy text
description: An identifier or an endpoint as typed, in mono, with a quiet button that copies it and shows a check.
use_for: Key IDs, model names, namespace IDs and endpoints in a definition list or a table cell.
never: Secrets after they were first shown
Sentences: copy text holds one value
A long value without room: it truncates, with the whole value in its title
body: `value` is what is copied and shown, `label` names it for the button ("copy key id"). The button is the console's: a 20px round hover in the sunken grey, as the branch draws it, the one round shape in the console. Copying uses the library's `useCopy`, which falls back to the copy command where the Clipboard API is refused. For a labelled Copy button use CopyButton.
